status: predeclared before heat modelling; accepted paired input and G5 freeze pending
purpose: Historical analytical model validation under WP4/E7; not an operational forecasting deployment
rationale: A chronological year-to-year split keeps a full seasonal cycle on each side of the proposed two-year window.
eligibility: Apply the accepted heat contract and identical no-fill complete-day rules; report exclusions independently for each side.
development_only: residual diagnostics used to choose uncertainty procedures
holdout_rule: Do not use holdout heating outcomes for exploration, tuning or selecting the station; score only after the development specification is fixed.
station_sensitivity: Use config/station-sensitivity-plan.json with identical boundaries; fit each model on its development data only and compare on declared common eligible days.
fallback: If accepted source alignment cannot support these boundaries, record a replacement split and its seasonal limitations before accessing heat-model outcomes; do not silently reuse this plan for a shorter period.
limits: Source-quality audits do not establish a fitted model. One year of holdout evidence does not prove causal effects, customer behaviour or future operational performance.
